name: memory_compact
description: Free room in persistent memory when `memory_save` was refused for budget. Archives the stalest facts of the writable project store until a fact as large as the biggest one kept will fit, and returns what moved — every archived name with its type and description. Nothing is deleted: archived facts leave the index but stay on disk, and the operator can restore any of them by name. Read-only grants and the profile layer are never touched. Call it after a budget refusal, then retry the save; calling it under budget archives nothing and says so.

reserve.description: Bytes of index headroom to free below the budget: the target is `budget - reserve`, a negative value counts as 0, any value is capped at half the budget, and 0 compacts to the budget itself. Omit for the default: the room the degraded-index warning demands (the budget minus `(90 * budget - 1) // 100`) plus the size of the largest index line the store holds -- at the default 24000-byte budget with a 39-byte largest line that is 2401 + 39 = 2440, a 21560-byte target.
